brand_spec.notes: Brand derived from classical liberal arts educational context - restrained elegance over flashiness. Typography-forward design with serif headings conveys authority and timelessness.

visual_direction.primary_change: No visual evolution — BrandSpec fidelity only. Classical motion philosophy implemented with 200ms override; serif-led typographic hierarchy reinforces mission-driven positioning. Single-page Wix anchor architecture preserved in section order while enabling per-route page layouts for the Next.js migration.
visual_direction.rationale: Stitch MCP unavailable; preserving source brand tokens exactly. The BrandSpec motion_philosophy='classical' is honored via motion-classical classes throughout, with motion_duration=200ms overriding the classical default of 400ms (per BrandSpec override precedence). Serif heading + sans body pairing is preserved as the core brand signal. No new colors introduced; all deltas trace to existing semantic_tokens.
designer_notes: Preserve Merriweather serif headings at all levels — core brand signal for authority and timelessness.
Hero overlay uses --color-on-surface at 0.55 alpha to ensure WCAG AA contrast on hero background image regardless of underlying photo brightness.
Service card icons (web-design, mobile-apps, brand-messaging, build-interest) sit on --color-primary-container (#EEF2FF) tiles for subtle, classical accent.
All CTAs use motion-classical with 200ms (BrandSpec override of classical default 400ms) — restrained, not flashy.
Portfolio gallery uses card.elevated variant on hover; --shadow-md elevation + 1.02 scale via motion-classical.
Form inputs use input.filled variant on focus with --brand-accent focus ring (WCAG-compliant 3px ring at 15% alpha).
Dark mode: full_tokens strategy is already declared in BrandSpec; ensure --brand-background, --brand-text, --color-surface, --color-on-surface all flip in [data-theme='dark'].
prefers-reduced-motion is mandatory: all motion-classical transforms collapse to opacity-only fades.
Footer uses footer_surface semantic token to softly separate from page background without introducing a new color.

ui_polish_changes.change: Added :focus-visible outline (3px solid --brand-accent) on every interactive element to guarantee WCAG-visible focus without per-component overrides.
ui_polish_changes.reason: Source Wix template relied on browser-default focus rings; the BrandSpec motion_philosophy=classical demands restrained, on-brand interaction feedback rather than verbose per-component focus styling.

ui_polish_changes.change: Introduced a .motion-classical utility that applies 200ms ease-out transitions to transform/opacity/shadow/color/background.
ui_polish_changes.reason: VisualDirection motion_delta specifies duration_override_ms=200 (overriding classical default of 400ms) and easing=ease-out. A shared utility enforces the override in one place across nav, hero, cards, gallery, form, and footer.

ui_polish_changes.change: Added a global prefers-reduced-motion block that collapses all transitions/animations to 0.01ms and disables smooth-scroll.
ui_polish_changes.reason: VisualDirection requires prefers-reduced-motion=required and the task's accessibility success criteria demand reduced-motion support. Avoids per-component media queries.

ui_polish_changes.change: Defined full light + dark token sets under :root and [data-theme="dark"], including flipped surface, on-surface, primary-container, muted, border, and shadow values.
ui_polish_changes.reason: BrandSpec.dark_mode_strategy=full_tokens mandates both light and dark token sets; [data-theme] selector (already used in tailwind.config.js) keeps the contract aligned.

ui_polish_changes.change: Set global type baseline (h1–h6 use Merriweather, body uses Source Sans 3) and applied text-wrap: balance utility class for headings.
ui_polish_changes.reason: VisualDirection typography_hierarchy preserves serif heading + sans body pairing and tight tracking on h1; balance utility improves widow control on long headlines without media queries.

ui_polish_changes.change: Applied on-surface overlay at 0.55 alpha behind headline rather than a black gradient.
ui_polish_changes.reason: VisualDirection color_delta.hero_overlay = var(--color-on-surface) at 0.55 alpha guarantees WCAG AA contrast on the hero photo regardless of brightness, while staying inside the existing token contract.

ui_polish_changes.change: Each service icon sits on a --color-primary-container tile inside a card-elevated wrapper that adds 1.02 scale + --shadow-md + accent border on hover.
ui_polish_changes.reason: VisualDirection requires service_card_hover = motion-classical with --shadow-md elevation and accent hover border; container background is from primary-container semantic token (#EEF2FF).

ui_polish_changes.change: Project tiles use card-elevated variant and apply motion-classical hover (lift -2px, scale 1.02, accent border); image inner overlay scales 1.05 for a subtle parallax effect.
ui_polish_changes.reason: VisualDirection motion_class_map.gallery_item_hover = motion-classical with 1.02 hover scale and -2px translate. Adds richness without breaking the restrained motion philosophy.

ui_polish_changes.change: Inputs use input.filled variant (surface background, accent focus ring at 15% alpha, 3px ring radius); submit button uses btn-primary with disabled state.
ui_polish_changes.reason: VisualDirection color_delta.form_focus_ring = var(--brand-accent) with WCAG-compliant 3px ring at 15% alpha. Filled variant comes from BrandSpec.component_variants.input.

ui_polish_changes.change: Footer surface uses var(--color-surface) instead of a separate gray, separating it from the page background without introducing a new color.
ui_polish_changes.reason: VisualDirection color_delta.footer_surface = var(--color-surface); avoids ad-hoc hex values and stays inside the semantic_tokens contract.

ui_polish_changes.change: Added Person and Organization JSON-LD blocks with founder, contactPoint, and sameAs links.
ui_polish_changes.reason: Source Wix site had an empty json_ld array. Adding structured data is a concrete SEO win and was explicitly called out in SiteArchitecture.architecture_decisions.
ui_polish_changes.brand_spec_reference: brand_spec (no direct token; SEO migration improvement from architecture_decisions[10])

ui_polish_changes.change: Inlined Google Fonts <link> with display=swap for Merriweather (400/700/900) and Source Sans 3 (400/600/700) and added preconnect hints.
ui_polish_changes.reason: Performance + visual stability: avoids FOUT for serif headings which are the core brand signal. Matches BrandSpec font_family_heading/body exactly.

ui_polish_changes.change: Single page composes all section components in the VisualDirection.section_order: hero → services → process → portfolio → contact → about → footer.
ui_polish_changes.reason: VisualDirection page_layouts./.section_order explicitly specifies this order; honoring it preserves the source information architecture while adding the about section above the footer for narrative closure.

ui_polish_changes.change: All copy lifted directly from SiteUnderstanding.text_content (preserving the 'Let's Talk', 'I'd Love to Hear From You', 'Don't resign yourself to mediocrity…' voice) and from ContentRecommendation.chosen_variant=A brand_preservation_notes.
ui_polish_changes.reason: Variant A was chosen specifically because the personal, warm voice has proven resonance with the existing client base; copying verbatim preserves brand equity and matches the preserve-and-modernize strategy.
ui_polish_changes.brand_spec_reference: chosen_variant=A + brand_preservation_notes (anti-pattern: never invent placeholder copy)

ui_polish_changes.change: Anchor links intercept clicks, run smooth scrollIntoView, and close the mobile menu on selection; sticky header uses backdrop-blur and a brand-border bottom rule when scrolled.
ui_polish_changes.reason: VisualDirection motion_class_map.nav_link_hover = motion-classical. Smooth-scroll behavior is gated by prefers-reduced-motion via the global CSS rule, satisfying VisualDirection.motion_delta.reduced_motion=required.

ui_polish_changes.change: Configured the brand color palette, type scale, spacing scale (xs=4px → 3xl=64px), border radius, and three-level brand shadow scale to mirror the BrandSpec tokens exactly.
ui_polish_changes.reason: Single source of truth between CSS custom properties and Tailwind utilities. Avoids the anti-pattern of hardcoded hex values in components and lets the ui_polish pass make all changes via tokens.
ui_polish_changes.brand_spec_reference: brand_spec.* (all color, type, spacing, radius, shadow fields)

visual_weight_issues: Hero CTA is the only primary-colored button visible above the fold; on long pages the eye can lose the conversion target once the user scrolls. Consider a sticky 'Let's Talk' chip on mobile only if engagement data justifies it.
typography_hierarchy_suggestions: h2 sizes use the VisualDirection default 3xl on all sections. A future iteration could differentiate hero (5xl) from process/services/portfolio (3xl) and about/contact (2xl) to add rhythmic depth to a long single-page scroll.

Eyebrow labels are present on services/process/portfolio/contact/about but not on the hero. Adding 'Mission' or 'Since 2024' above the hero headline would tie the brand heritage to the section hierarchy.
emotional_resonance_gaps: The classical liberal arts positioning is signaled through typography and the about-section copy, but a pull-quote or testimonial from Chesterton Academy of Akron or Holy Rollers would deepen trust for first-time visitors and is a noted SEO content opportunity in ContentRecommendation.

The hero image is high-quality but photography-forward; an additional motif (e.g., a small classical ornament SVG, a serif drop-cap on the h1) could reinforce the brand's classical heritage beyond typography alone.
brand_token_violations: None observed. Every color, font, and motion value traces back to either a BrandSpec token or a VisualDirection delta. No hardcoded hex values appear in component files.
self_critique.recommended_action: None - acceptable trade-off. The build is launch-ready; remaining items are post-launch iteration opportunities (testimonials, per-section typography depth) and do not block deployment.

deploy_blockers: RESEND_API_KEY must be set via fly secrets set before first contact-form submission
TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY must be set if Turnstile widget is enabled on the front-end (currently a no-op stub)
og/home.png and a real logo asset must be added to /public before social previews render correctly
deployment_readiness.deployment_target: fly.io app 'merimee-solutions' in cle region (per SiteArchitecture.deployment)

iteration_history.action: Generated all 14 source files, applied BrandSpec tokens to globals.css and tailwind.config.js, composed single-page route from 8 architecture components.
iteration_history.outcome: All files written; TypeScript strict mode satisfied; no hardcoded hex in components.

iteration_history.action: Logged 15 ui_polish changes tracing to BrandSpec fields and VisualDirection deltas (hero overlay opacity, motion-classical 200ms, prefers-reduced-motion, dark token flip, accent focus ring, card-elevated hover, JSON-LD, Google Fonts, section order, brand voice preservation, sticky nav motion).
iteration_history.outcome: Every change cross-referenced to a brand_spec_reference; no values invented.

iteration_history.action: Reviewed build for visual weight, typographic hierarchy, emotional resonance, and brand-token violations.
iteration_history.outcome: Severity=low. No brand_token_violations. Motion philosophy fully aligned. Two post-launch iteration opportunities noted (testimonials, per-section type scale).
